parties.respondent: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Ex parte decree under Order XVII Rule 2 CPC; applicability of explanation requiring substantial evidence recorded; explanation not applicable when defendant absents after plaintiff's evidence; Order IX Rule 13 application for setting aside decree; High Court interference improper without satisfying 'sufficient cause'; impugned judgment set aside; decree reinstated.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order IX Rule 13
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XVII Rule 2
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; ex parte decree restored.
